DrugId.description: A published native drug record identifier, without a consumer source prefix.

DrugSection.description: Explicit drug disclosures; identity cards never expand into these sections.
x-enum-descriptions: All native identity cross-references and product links, mechanically paged.
Native CIViC therapy evidence and profile context.
Native application and product history rows.
Native DDInter partner rows and levels; five rows per default page, with explicit section limits preserved.

Text.description: Bounded nonempty text with surrounding Unicode whitespace removed.

description: Retrieve a drug by source-native ID, brand or generic name, with explicit source-scoped sections.

civic_cursor.description: Native continuation cursor for that exact drug, profile and claim collection.

civic_kind.description: Independent native evidence or assertion collection within the selected profile.

civic_profile.description: Selected native CIViC molecular profile for a drug-scoped claim stream.

input.description: Source-native ID or complete brand or generic name; WHO references retain native spaces. Exact brands rank before generics; Drugs@FDA prefers NDA/BLA before ANDA, then earliest approval. Other sources retain search order. The chosen record reports up to five alternatives and their total. Generic names also accept one trailing listed salt or ester term: mesylate, hydrochloride, sodium, potassium, calcium, sulfate, maleate, tartrate, citrate, phosphate, acetate, besylate, fumarate, succinate, tosylate, bromide, chloride. Brand names identical to their own ingredient count as generic. USAN nomenclature: https://www.ama-assn.org/about/united-states-adopted-names-usan/united-states-adopted-names-naming-guidelines

label_section.description: Exact native label heading, required only for the label section.

product_number.description: Explicit native application product number, only for approvals.

section.description: Explicit named disclosures; empty means identity only.

section_limit.description: Named section page size, refused on an identity-only card.

section_offset.description: Named section continuation, refused on an identity-only card.

source.description: Omit to infer the source of an unambiguous section; identity or mixed sections use MyChem.
